items.name: Frag grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. Creatures in a 20-ft radius make a DC 13 Dex save: 2d6 piercing, half on a success. (House rule)

items.name: Krak grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft at one target or object: ranged attack, 4d6 force on a hit. (House rule)

items.name: Smoke grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. Heavy obscurement in a 20-ft radius for 1 minute.

items.name: Photon flash grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. Creatures in 15 ft make a DC 13 Con save or are Blinded until the end of their next turn. (House rule)

items.name: Melta bomb
items.desc: Placed as an action on a structure or vehicle; detonates next turn for 8d6 fire. (House rule)

items.name: Medi-stimm
items.desc: Bonus action: regain 2d4 + 2 HP.

items.name: Greater medi-stimm
items.desc: Bonus action: regain 4d4 + 4 HP.

items.name: Combat stimm
items.desc: For 1 minute: +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength checks. Afterwards, gain 1 exhaustion. (House rule)

items.name: De-tox injector
items.desc: Ends the Poisoned condition.

items.name: Medi-kit
items.desc: Ten uses. Stabilise a dying creature without a check.

items.name: Corpse-starch bars
items.desc: One day of rations. Don't ask what's in it.

items.name: Recaf flask
items.desc: Stays hot for a day.

items.name: Spare power cell
items.desc: Ammunition for las weapons.

items.name: Bolt shells
items.desc: Box of mass-reactive rounds for bolt weapons.

items.name: Shotgun shells
items.desc: Box of shells.

items.name: Stub rounds
items.desc: Box of solid rounds for autoguns and stub weapons.

items.name: Promethium canister
items.desc: Fuel for flamers.

items.name: Plasma flask
items.desc: Fuel for plasma weapons.

items.name: Glow-globe
items.desc: Bright light in a 20-ft radius.

items.name: Grapnel and cable
items.desc: 50 ft of cable with a launcher hook.

items.name: Magnoculars
items.desc: See up to a mile away in detail.

items.name: Auspex
items.desc: Detects life signs and energy within 60 ft through thin walls.

items.name: Multikey
items.desc: Advantage on checks to open mechanical and simple electronic locks.

items.name: Rebreather
items.desc: Breathe in toxic air or underwater for 1 hour.

items.name: Void suit
items.desc: Survive vacuum for 1 hour.

items.name: Vox-bead
items.desc: Short-range comms with the rest of the crew.

items.name: Data-slate
items.desc: Stores and displays records.

items.name: Combi-tool
items.desc: Counts as tinker's tools.

items.name: Filtration plugs
items.desc: Advantage on saves against inhaled toxins.

items.name: Manacles
items.desc: Restrain a Medium or smaller creature.

items.name: Aquila pendant
items.desc: Holy symbol of the Imperium; a Faith focus.

items.name: Flak vest
items.desc: Light armour. AC 11 + Dex. Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Mesh armour
items.desc: Light armour. AC 12 + Dex. Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Flak armour
items.desc: Medium armour. AC 13 + Dex (max 2). Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Heavy flak
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 14. Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Carapace chestplate
items.desc: Medium armour. AC 14 + Dex (max 2). Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Storm-trooper carapace
items.desc: Medium armour. AC 15 + Dex (max 2). Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Heavy carapace
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 16 (Str 13). Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Full carapace
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 18 (Str 15). Tap Wear in your gear to put it on.

items.name: Combat shield
items.desc: +2 AC while carried.

items.name: Thrones
items.desc: Imperial currency.

items.name: Red-dot sight
items.desc: +1 to attack rolls. Fits any ranged weapon.

items.name: Telescopic sight
items.desc: No disadvantage at long range. Fits two-handed ranged weapons.

items.name: Suppressor
items.desc: Shots are silent; firing from hiding doesn't give away your position. Fits one-handed ranged weapons.

items.name: Extended magazine
items.desc: Clip size +50%. Fits any weapon with a clip.

items.name: Hot-shot cells
items.desc: +2 damage; clip size halved. Fits las weapons.

items.name: Bayonet
items.desc: Can make melee attacks: 1d4 + Str piercing. Fits two-handed ranged weapons.

items.name: Underslung grenade launcher
items.desc: Fire a grenade from your gear at 60/180 ft instead of throwing it. Fits two-handed ranged weapons.

items.name: Monomolecular edge
items.desc: +1 damage. Fits blades.

items.name: Shock coil
items.desc: On a hit, the target can't take reactions until its next turn. Fits melee weapons.

items.name: Duelling grip
items.desc: +1 to attack rolls. Fits melee weapons.

items.name: Feral-world plate
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 16. Hand-beaten steel from a world that never left the dark ages. Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Void armour
items.desc: Medium armour. AC 14 + Dex (max 1). Armoured void suit: you can survive in vacuum for 1 hour.

items.name: Ork 'eavy armour
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 15 (Str 15). Scrap plates bolted together. Disadvantage on Stealth, and on Persuasion with anyone who has a nose.

items.name: Enforcer carapace
items.desc: Medium armour. AC 14 + Dex (max 2). Arbites-pattern plates with a rebreather and a photo-visor built into the helm (darkvision 30 ft).

items.name: Aeldari mesh armour
items.desc: Light armour. AC 14 + Dex. Thermoplastic xenos mesh that hardens under impact. No Stealth penalty.

items.name: Light power armour
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 18. Inquisitorial-pattern powered plate. While you wear it, your Strength counts as 2 higher for carrying and Athletics.

items.name: Sororitas power armour
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 19 (Str 13). Holy power armour of the Adepta Sororitas, sealed against vacuum and blessed against the Warp: advantage on saves against Corruption.

items.name: Astartes power armour
items.desc: Heavy armour. AC 20. Made for Space Marines. An unaugmented human can barely move in it: speed 10 ft and disadvantage on Dex checks and saves.

items.name: Suppression shield
items.desc: Shield, +2 AC. A riot shield with a shock plate: when you shove with it, the target can't take reactions until its next turn.

items.name: Storm shield
items.desc: Shield, +2 AC. A power-field shield: once per short rest, as a reaction, reduce the damage of one hit by 2d10.

items.name: Refractor field
items.desc: Belt-worn energy field (requires attunement). Reaction when hit: +5 AC against that attack. Once per short rest.

items.name: Conversion field
items.desc: Energy field (requires attunement). Reaction when hit by a ranged attack: take half damage, and creatures within 10 ft make a DC 13 Con save or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.

items.name: Displacer field
items.desc: Archeotech teleport field (requires attunement). Reaction when hit: the attack misses and you teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see. Recharges on a d6 roll of 5–6 at the start of each of your turns.

items.name: Rosarius
items.desc: An Ecclesiarchy amulet that projects a field of faith (requires attunement). Once per day, when you take damage, reduce it to 0.

items.name: Iron halo
items.desc: A halo-shaped field generator awarded to heroes (requires attunement). +1 AC, and once per short rest you can turn one critical hit against you into a normal hit.

items.name: Stikkbomb
items.desc: Ork frag on a stick. Thrown 40 ft, 10-ft radius, DC 12 Dex save: 2d6 slashing, half on a success. On a 1 on a d20 it is a dud (or goes off in your hand, GM's call).

items.name: Incendiary grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 10-ft radius burns for 1 minute: DC 13 Dex save or 2d6 fire and catch fire. Anyone entering or starting there takes 1d6 fire.

items.name: Stun grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 10-ft radius, DC 13 Con save or stunned until the end of its next turn. No damage.

items.name: Choke gas grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 20-ft cloud for 1 minute. DC 13 Con save on entering or starting a turn in it: 2d6 poison and poisoned while inside. Rebreathers protect.

items.name: Blind grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 20-ft cloud of smoke and chaff for 1 minute: heavy obscurement that also blocks darkvision, photo-visors and auspex scans.

items.name: Web grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 10-ft radius, DC 13 Dex save or restrained (escape DC 13 Str, as an action).

items.name: Haywire grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 15-ft radius, 3d6 lightning, DC 14 Dex save for half. Constructs, servitors, vehicles and powered armour take double and shut down until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Hallucinogen grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 20-ft radius, DC 14 Wis save or, on its next turn, the target does something random (roll d4: attack the nearest creature, flee, babble, or freeze).

items.name: Plasma grenade
items.desc: Thrown 60 ft. 10-ft radius, DC 14 Dex save: 4d6 fire, half on a success.

items.name: Demolition charge
items.desc: Placed, with a timer up to 1 hour or a remote detonator. 20-ft radius, DC 15 Dex save: 6d6 thunder, half on a success. Double damage to structures.

items.name: Dum-dum rounds
items.desc: Stub and autogun rounds that flatten on impact: +2 damage against targets without armour, −1 to hit against armoured targets. One reload.

items.name: Man-stopper rounds
items.desc: Stub, autogun and shotgun rounds with hardened tips: ignore resistance from mundane armour. One reload.

items.name: Tox rounds
items.desc: Stub, autogun and needle rounds coated in toxin: the weapon gains Toxic. One reload.

items.name: Inferno shells
items.desc: Shotgun shells packed with promethium: on a hit the target catches fire (1d4 fire at the start of each turn until doused). One reload.

items.name: Hot-shot charge pack
items.desc: Overcharged las power pack: +1d8 damage per hit, but the weapon gains Overheat while it is loaded. 5 shots.

items.name: Kraken penetrator shells
items.desc: Bolt shells with adamantine cores: the weapon gains Rending and ignores resistance. One reload.

items.name: Hellfire shells
items.desc: Bolt shells filled with mutagenic acid: +1d6 acid per hit, and the weapon gains Toxic. One reload.

items.name: Frag missile
items.desc: Missile launcher round: 4d6 fire, Blast. (This is what the launcher's card shows.)

items.name: Krak missile
items.desc: Missile launcher round for armour: 6d10 force against one target, no Blast. Double damage against vehicles and structures.

items.name: Melta canister
items.desc: Pressurised fuel for melta weapons and inferno pistols. One reload.

items.name: Web canister
items.desc: Refill for web pistols and webbers. One reload.

items.name: Lho-sticks (pack)
items.desc: Ten mildly narcotic smokes. The universal currency of the Imperial Guard.

items.name: Bottle of amasec
items.desc: Imperial brandy, quality varying from "fine" to "engine cleaner". Advantage on Persuasion when you share it with the right person.

items.name: Synth-skin patch
items.desc: Spray-on artificial skin. Action: gain 2d6 + 2 temporary HP for 1 hour.

items.name: Anti-plague serum
items.desc: Cures one disease, or gives advantage on saves against disease for 24 hours.

items.name: Obscura
items.desc: A dreamy narcotic. For 1 hour: advantage on saves against being frightened, disadvantage on Perception and Insight. Addictive.

items.name: Blood-replacement unit
items.desc: A bag of synthetic blood with a pump. Action: a dying creature is stabilised and regains 4d4 + 4 HP.

items.name: Frenzon
items.desc: A rage drug used on penal legion troops. For 1 minute: advantage on melee attacks, immune to frightened, can't take reactions. Afterwards: DC 13 Con save or 1 level of exhaustion.

items.name: Slaught
items.desc: A reflex accelerator. For 1 minute: +10 ft speed, +2 AC and advantage on Dex saves. Afterwards: 1 level of exhaustion.

items.name: Spook
items.desc: A forbidden psychoactive drug from the Koronus Expanse. For 10 minutes you can use one random psychic cantrip (GM's pick) even if you are not a psyker. Gain 1d4 Corruption.

items.name: Holy water (blessed vial)
items.desc: Thrown 20 ft (ranged attack): 2d6 radiant against daemons and the undead. Ordinary water to everyone else.

items.name: Chrono
items.desc: A wrist timepiece. Never late again (in theory).

items.name: Survival kit
items.desc: Fire-starter, water purifier, signal mirror, snare wire. Advantage on Survival checks to forage or find shelter.

items.name: Signal flare
items.desc: Lights up a 60-ft radius in bright light for 1 minute, or signals a ship in orbit.

items.name: Lascutter
items.desc: A handheld cutting laser for doors and wreckage. Cuts through a bulkhead in 1 minute. Improvised melee weapon: 2d6 fire, disadvantage to hit.

items.name: Photo-visor
items.desc: Goggles that turn darkness into grey-green daylight: darkvision 60 ft.

items.name: Vox-caster (long range)
items.desc: A backpack vox set. Talks to ships in orbit and to anyone in the same city.

items.name: Writ of passage
items.desc: Official-looking paperwork granting passage. Advantage on Deception or Persuasion with minor officials, until someone checks.

items.name: Preysense goggles
items.desc: Thermal goggles. You see warm bodies through smoke, fog and darkness up to 60 ft, and you can't be surprised by living creatures in that range.

items.name: Chameleoline cloak
items.desc: A cloak that takes on the colours behind it. Advantage on Stealth while you don't move more than 10 ft in a turn.

items.name: Stummer
items.desc: A sound-dampening field generator. Advantage on Stealth checks against anyone relying on hearing.

items.name: Grav-chute
items.desc: A backpack anti-grav unit. You take no falling damage and can glide 2 ft horizontally for every 1 ft you fall.

items.name: Holo-mask
items.desc: A hologram projector that covers your face with someone else's. Advantage on Deception to pass as them; a close look (DC 15 Investigation) sees the flicker.

items.name: Jump pack
items.desc: A rocket pack. Bonus action: fly up to 60 ft in a straight-ish line and land. Three uses, then refuel (100 Thrones).

items.name: Servo-skull (utility)
items.desc: A floating skull with a lamp and a recorder. It follows you, lights a 20-ft radius and records what it sees.

items.name: Servo-skull (combat)
items.desc: A floating skull with a needle gun. Bonus action: it makes a ranged attack, +4 to hit, 1d4 piercing + Toxic, 30 ft. AC 13, 10 HP.

items.name: Bionic eye
items.desc: Cybernetic. Darkvision 30 ft, and advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight at long range.

items.name: Bionic arm
items.desc: Cybernetic. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, and you have advantage on Athletics checks to lift, push or grapple.

items.name: Respirator implant
items.desc: Cybernetic. Immune to inhaled poisons and gases, and you can hold your breath for 10 minutes.

items.name: Mechadendrite (utility)
items.desc: Cybernetic tentacle-arm with tools. Bonus action: interact with an object or take the Help action for a Tech or Medicine check.

items.name: Mind-impulse unit
items.desc: Cybernetic. You can control a machine you touch by thought, and command servo-skulls and simple servitors as a bonus action.

items.name: Psy-focus
items.desc: A crystal, rosary or skull that helps a psyker concentrate (requires attunement by a psyker). +1 to psychic power save DCs.

items.name: Psychic hood
items.desc: A crystalline cowl that shields a psyker's mind (requires attunement by a psyker). Advantage on saves against Perils of the Warp and to keep concentration.

items.name: Null rod
items.desc: A staff of blank-null materials. Psychic powers targeting you or cast within 10 ft have disadvantage to hit (or advantage on the save against them).

items.name: Egarian geode
items.desc: A fist-sized crystal from a xenos maze-city. It is always warm, and it hums when it is near Egarian stone. Collectors pay very well.

items.name: Archeotech auspex
items.desc: A dark-age scanner. It detects life, energy and hidden doors within 120 ft through anything but lead, and shows a map of the area.

items.name: Halo device
items.desc: A xenos artefact that grants unnatural life. Attune: +1 to Con and you age no further. Each month, DC 15 Wis save or gain 1d4 Corruption. Many have killed for one.

items.name: Warp-touched compass
items.desc: A compass whose needle points at whatever its holder most wants. It is never wrong. It is often unkind.

items.name: Combat shotgun
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 30/90 ft. 5e: Shotgun. A pump or semi-automatic shotgun, the boarding party's best friend.
items.flavor: A pump or semi-automatic shotgun, the boarding party's best friend.

items.name: Cudgel
items.desc: 1d4 bludgeoning. 5e: Club. A weighted cudgel. Every hive enforcer starts with one.
items.flavor: A weighted cudgel. Every hive enforcer starts with one.

items.name: Combat knife
items.desc: 1d4 piercing. 5e: Dagger. A plain combat knife: utility tool, last resort and the most honest weapon in the galaxy.
items.flavor: A plain combat knife: utility tool, last resort and the most honest weapon in the galaxy.

items.name: Ogryn maul
items.desc: 1d8 bludgeoning. 5e: Great club. A slab of iron sized for an Ogryn. Humans can lift it. Swinging it is another matter.
items.flavor: A slab of iron sized for an Ogryn. Humans can lift it. Swinging it is another matter.

items.name: Hatchet
items.desc: 1d6 slashing. 5e: Hand axe. A small hatchet, good for chopping, throwing and settling disputes on the lower decks.
items.flavor: A small hatchet, good for chopping, throwing and settling disputes on the lower decks.

items.name: Throwing spear
items.desc: 1d6 piercing, 30/120 ft. 5e: Javelin. A light throwing spear for hunting and skirmishes on feral worlds.
items.flavor: A light throwing spear for hunting and skirmishes on feral worlds.

items.name: Hammer
items.desc: 1d4 bludgeoning. 5e: Light hammer. A one-handed hammer, as handy for ship repairs as for heads.
items.flavor: A one-handed hammer, as handy for ship repairs as for heads.

items.name: Shock maul
items.desc: 1d6 bludgeoning. 5e: Mace. A short maul with a shock generator in the head. Arbites call it "the conversation ender".
items.flavor: A short maul with a shock generator in the head. Arbites call it "the conversation ender".

items.name: Force stave
items.desc: 1d6 bludgeoning. 5e: Quarter staff. A psyker's staff threaded with psychoactive circuitry. Doubles as a walking stick and a warning.
items.flavor: A psyker's staff threaded with psychoactive circuitry. Doubles as a walking stick and a warning.

items.name: Hooked blade
items.desc: 1d4 slashing. 5e: Sickle. A hooked blade for cutting cables, crops and hamstrings.
items.flavor: A hooked blade for cutting cables, crops and hamstrings.

items.name: Spear
items.desc: 1d6 piercing. 5e: Spear. A simple spear. Feral warriors and desperate militias still trust them.
items.flavor: A simple spear. Feral warriors and desperate militias still trust them.

items.name: Throwing knife
items.desc: 1d4 piercing, 20/60 ft. 5e: Dart. Balanced knives for throwing. Carry several.
items.flavor: Balanced knives for throwing. Carry several.

items.name: Lasgun
items.desc: 1d8 radiant, 120/360 ft. 5e: Light crossbow. The Imperial Guard's standard rifle. It fires focused light, never jams and recharges from almost any power source.
items.flavor: The Imperial Guard's standard rifle. It fires focused light, never jams and recharges from almost any power source.

items.name: Autogun
items.desc: 1d8 piercing, 100/300 ft. 5e: Short bow. A cheap automatic rifle firing solid rounds. Less reliable than a lasgun, but easy to feed.
items.flavor: A cheap automatic rifle firing solid rounds. Less reliable than a lasgun, but easy to feed.

items.name: Stub pistol
items.desc: 1d6 piercing, 50/150 ft. 5e: Sling. A simple revolver or autoloading stub gun. Every hive sells them, most of them work.
items.flavor: A simple revolver or autoloading stub gun. Every hive sells them, most of them work.

items.name: Chain-axe
items.desc: 1d8 slashing. 5e: Battle axe. An axe with a motorised chain of teeth. Messy, loud and effective.
items.flavor: An axe with a motorised chain of teeth. Messy, loud and effective.

items.name: Flail
items.desc: 1d8 bludgeoning. 5e: Flail. A spiked ball on a chain, popular with Ecclesiarchy zealots.
items.flavor: A spiked ball on a chain, popular with Ecclesiarchy zealots.

items.name: Power glaive
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. 5e: Glaive. A long blade on a haft, sheathed in a disruption field. A weapon of honour guards.
items.flavor: A long blade on a haft, sheathed in a disruption field. A weapon of honour guards.

items.name: Heavy chain-axe
items.desc: 1d12 slashing. 5e: Great axe. A two-handed chain-axe. Heavy, brutal and very loud.
items.flavor: A two-handed chain-axe. Heavy, brutal and very loud.

items.name: Eviscerator
items.desc: 2d6 slashing. 5e: Great sword. A huge two-handed chainsword, favoured by Ecclesiarchy crusaders. It needs both hands and some faith.
items.flavor: A huge two-handed chainsword, favoured by Ecclesiarchy crusaders. It needs both hands and some faith.

items.name: Power halberd
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. 5e: Halberd. An axe-headed polearm wrapped in a disruption field, carried by palace guards and Custodian imitators.
items.flavor: An axe-headed polearm wrapped in a disruption field, carried by palace guards and Custodian imitators.

items.name: Power lance
items.desc: 1d10 piercing. 5e: Lance. A long power lance for mounted charges, or for very determined people on foot.
items.flavor: A long power lance for mounted charges, or for very determined people on foot.

items.name: Chainsword
items.desc: 1d8 slashing. 5e: Long sword. A sword with a motorised chain of teeth. The iconic close-combat weapon of the Imperium.
items.flavor: A sword with a motorised chain of teeth. The iconic close-combat weapon of the Imperium.

items.name: Thunder maul
items.desc: 2d6 bludgeoning. 5e: Maul. A heavy two-handed maul with a crude shock charge. Cheaper cousin of the thunder hammer.
items.flavor: A heavy two-handed maul with a crude shock charge. Cheaper cousin of the thunder hammer.

items.name: Spiked maul
items.desc: 1d8 piercing. 5e: Morning star. A heavy maul with a spiked head. Crude, reliable, terrifying.
items.flavor: A heavy maul with a spiked head. Crude, reliable, terrifying.

items.name: Power pike
items.desc: 1d10 piercing. 5e: Pike. A long pike with an energised tip, for holding a line.
items.flavor: A long pike with an energised tip, for holding a line.

items.name: Power sword
items.desc: 1d8 piercing. 5e: Rapier. A slim blade sheathed in a crackling disruption field. The mark of officers, nobles and Rogue Traders.
items.flavor: A slim blade sheathed in a crackling disruption field. The mark of officers, nobles and Rogue Traders.

items.name: Duelling sabre
items.desc: 1d6 slashing. 5e: Scimitar. A curved fencing sabre for nobles and void-duellists.
items.flavor: A curved fencing sabre for nobles and void-duellists.

items.name: Gladius
items.desc: 1d6 piercing. 5e: Short sword. A short stabbing sword, standard issue for boarding parties.
items.flavor: A short stabbing sword, standard issue for boarding parties.

items.name: Trident
items.desc: 1d8 piercing. 5e: Trident. A three-pronged spear, favoured by gladiators in the pit-fights of the underhive.
items.flavor: A three-pronged spear, favoured by gladiators in the pit-fights of the underhive.

items.name: Power pick
items.desc: 1d8 piercing. 5e: War pick. A power-field pick for breaching armour plate. Tech-Priests carry them as tools.
items.flavor: A power-field pick for breaching armour plate. Tech-Priests carry them as tools.

items.name: Power hammer
items.desc: 1d8 bludgeoning. 5e: War hammer. A one-handed hammer sheathed in a disruption field.
items.flavor: A one-handed hammer sheathed in a disruption field.

items.name: Neural whip
items.desc: 1d4 slashing. 5e: Whip. A whip that stimulates every nerve it touches. A slaver's favourite.
items.flavor: A whip that stimulates every nerve it touches. A slaver's favourite.

items.name: Needle pistol
items.desc: 1d4 piercing + poison, 60/180 ft. 5e: Blowgun. A silent pistol that fires toxin-coated needles. An assassin's tool.
items.flavor: A silent pistol that fires toxin-coated needles. An assassin's tool.

items.name: Laspistol
items.desc: 1d6 radiant, 60/180 ft. 5e: Hand crossbow. The standard Imperial sidearm: a las pistol that never jams and never runs dry for long.
items.flavor: The standard Imperial sidearm: a las pistol that never jams and never runs dry for long.

items.name: Boltgun
items.desc: 2d6 piercing, 120/360 ft. 5e: Heavy crossbow. The holy bolter: rocket-propelled shells that explode inside the target. Rare outside the Astartes and the very rich.
items.flavor: The holy bolter: rocket-propelled shells that explode inside the target. Rare outside the Astartes and the very rich.

items.name: Hellgun
items.desc: 1d10 radiant, 120/360 ft. 5e: Long bow. A las rifle wired to a backpack power pack, firing overcharged bolts that punch through armour.
items.flavor: A las rifle wired to a backpack power pack, firing overcharged bolts that punch through armour.

items.name: Autopistol
items.desc: 1d6 piercing, 50/150 ft. A cheap automatic sidearm found in every hive gang and ship crew. It sprays more than it aims, but it keeps heads down.
items.flavor: A cheap automatic sidearm found in every hive gang and ship crew. It sprays more than it aims, but it keeps heads down.

items.name: Hand cannon
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 40/120 ft. An oversized stub revolver beloved of bounty hunters and Rogue Trader bodyguards. Five shots, each one a statement.
items.flavor: An oversized stub revolver beloved of bounty hunters and Rogue Trader bodyguards. Five shots, each one a statement.

items.name: Duelling pistol
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 60/180 ft. A noble's single-shot pistol with an engraved barrel, made for affairs of honour at twenty paces.
items.flavor: A noble's single-shot pistol with an engraved barrel, made for affairs of honour at twenty paces.

items.name: Bolt pistol
items.desc: 2d4 piercing, 40/120 ft. A compact bolter that fires rocket-propelled shells which detonate inside the target. Carried by officers, Rogue Traders and anyone who wants to be taken seriously.
items.flavor: A compact bolter that fires rocket-propelled shells which detonate inside the target. Carried by officers, Rogue Traders and anyone who wants to be taken seriously.

items.name: Hellpistol
items.desc: 1d10 radiant, 40/120 ft. A las pistol fed from a backpack power pack. Its overcharged bolts burn through flak like paper. Favoured by storm troopers and Inquisitorial agents.
items.flavor: A las pistol fed from a backpack power pack. Its overcharged bolts burn through flak like paper. Favoured by storm troopers and Inquisitorial agents.

items.name: Plasma pistol
items.desc: 2d6 fire, 40/120 ft. A sidearm that fires sun-hot bolts of plasma. Devastating, temperamental, and prone to cooking the hand that holds it.
items.flavor: A sidearm that fires sun-hot bolts of plasma. Devastating, temperamental, and prone to cooking the hand that holds it.

items.name: Inferno pistol
items.desc: 4d6 fire, 15/30 ft. A hand-sized melta weapon of exquisite workmanship. At arm's length it turns armour into slag. Few forges can still make them.
items.flavor: A hand-sized melta weapon of exquisite workmanship. At arm's length it turns armour into slag. Few forges can still make them.

items.name: Hand flamer
items.desc: 2d6 fire, 15 ft. A short-barrelled promethium sprayer for clearing corridors and settling arguments in tight spaces.
items.flavor: A short-barrelled promethium sprayer for clearing corridors and settling arguments in tight spaces.

items.name: Web pistol
items.desc: 1 bludgeoning, 30/60 ft. Fires a spray of fast-hardening filaments that wraps a target up without killing it. Popular with Arbites and slavers.
items.flavor: Fires a spray of fast-hardening filaments that wraps a target up without killing it. Popular with Arbites and slavers.

items.name: Slugga
items.desc: 1d8 piercing, 40/120 ft. An Ork pistol: a pipe, a trigger and a lot of optimism. Loud enough to count as a war cry.
items.flavor: An Ork pistol: a pipe, a trigger and a lot of optimism. Loud enough to count as a war cry.

items.name: Shuriken pistol
items.desc: 1d8 slashing, 40/120 ft. An Aeldari sidearm that fires monomolecular discs shaved from a crystal core. Silent, elegant and terribly sharp.
items.flavor: An Aeldari sidearm that fires monomolecular discs shaved from a crystal core. Silent, elegant and terribly sharp.

items.name: Splinter pistol
items.desc: 1d4 piercing, 40/120 ft. A Drukhari pistol that flings poisoned crystal slivers. It is made to hurt, not to kill quickly.
items.flavor: A Drukhari pistol that flings poisoned crystal slivers. It is made to hurt, not to kill quickly.

items.name: Pulse pistol
items.desc: 1d8 radiant, 60/180 ft. A T'au sidearm firing induction-driven plasma pulses. Clean lines, steady output, no prayers required.
items.flavor: A T'au sidearm firing induction-driven plasma pulses. Clean lines, steady output, no prayers required.

items.name: Lascarbine
items.desc: 1d8 radiant, 80/240 ft. A shortened lasgun for vehicle crews, scouts and boarding parties. Lighter, faster to swing round a corner.
items.flavor: A shortened lasgun for vehicle crews, scouts and boarding parties. Lighter, faster to swing round a corner.

items.name: Long-las
items.desc: 1d12 radiant, 150/600 ft. A long-barrelled sniper las with a precision scope. Feral-world hunters and Guard marksmen swear by them.
items.flavor: A long-barrelled sniper las with a precision scope. Feral-world hunters and Guard marksmen swear by them.

items.name: Hunting rifle
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 150/450 ft. A bolt-action stub rifle for game hunting on frontier worlds. Simple, accurate and easy to repair.
items.flavor: A bolt-action stub rifle for game hunting on frontier worlds. Simple, accurate and easy to repair.

items.name: Pump shotgun
items.desc: 1d8 piercing, 30/90 ft. A cheaper, slower cousin of the combat shotgun, found behind every hive bar.
items.flavor: A cheaper, slower cousin of the combat shotgun, found behind every hive bar.

items.name: Needle rifle
items.desc: 1d6 piercing, 120/360 ft. Fires a laser-guided toxin needle without a sound. The preferred tool of assassins and very patient people.
items.flavor: Fires a laser-guided toxin needle without a sound. The preferred tool of assassins and very patient people.

items.name: Storm bolter
items.desc: 2d6 piercing, 90/270 ft. Two boltguns welded side by side with a single trigger. A weapon of Terminators and Inquisitors.
items.flavor: Two boltguns welded side by side with a single trigger. A weapon of Terminators and Inquisitors.

items.name: Shoota
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 60/180 ft. An Ork automatic rifle. It has a magazine, a trigger and several bits nobody can explain.
items.flavor: An Ork automatic rifle. It has a magazine, a trigger and several bits nobody can explain.

items.name: Kroot rifle
items.desc: 1d10 piercing, 120/360 ft. A long slug-thrower fitted with curved blades at both ends, as handy in a melee as at range.
items.flavor: A long slug-thrower fitted with curved blades at both ends, as handy in a melee as at range.

items.name: Shuriken catapult
items.desc: 1d10 slashing, 90/270 ft. The Aeldari warrior's rifle: a hail of razor discs fired by gravitic pulses.
items.flavor: The Aeldari warrior's rifle: a hail of razor discs fired by gravitic pulses.

items.name: Splinter rifle
items.desc: 1d6 piercing, 120/360 ft. The standard Drukhari rifle. Every splinter carries a venom chosen for how long it takes to work.
items.flavor: The standard Drukhari rifle. Every splinter carries a venom chosen for how long it takes to work.

items.name: Pulse rifle
items.desc: 1d12 radiant, 150/450 ft. A T'au infantry rifle with range and punch that put Imperial lasguns to shame.
items.flavor: A T'au infantry rifle with range and punch that put Imperial lasguns to shame.

items.name: Arc rifle
items.desc: 2d6 lightning, 90/270 ft. A Mechanicus weapon that hurls bolts of electricity, frying machines and the people inside them.
items.flavor: A Mechanicus weapon that hurls bolts of electricity, frying machines and the people inside them.

items.name: Radium carbine
items.desc: 1d8 necrotic, 90/270 ft. Skitarii carbine firing radioactive rounds. Anyone who survives the hit has a long illness to look forward to.
items.flavor: Skitarii carbine firing radioactive rounds. Anyone who survives the hit has a long illness to look forward to.

items.name: Galvanic rifle
items.desc: 2d8 piercing, 150/600 ft. A Skitarii sniper rifle whose rounds turn the target's own bio-electricity against them.
items.flavor: A Skitarii sniper rifle whose rounds turn the target's own bio-electricity against them.

items.name: Volkite caliver
items.desc: 3d8 fire, 90/270 ft. A dark-age heat-ray weapon. Targets do not burn so much as flash into ash. The Mechanicus would kill to own one.
items.flavor: A dark-age heat-ray weapon. Targets do not burn so much as flash into ash. The Mechanicus would kill to own one.

items.name: Gauss flayer
items.desc: 2d10 necrotic, 120/360 ft. An ancient xenos weapon that strips its target apart molecule by molecule. It hums, and it never needs reloading by any human means.
items.flavor: An ancient xenos weapon that strips its target apart molecule by molecule. It hums, and it never needs reloading by any human means.

items.name: Flamer
items.desc: 3d6 fire, 30 ft. A promethium projector, the classic tool for purging hives, heretics and anything with too many legs.
items.flavor: A promethium projector, the classic tool for purging hives, heretics and anything with too many legs.

items.name: Plasma gun
items.desc: 2d8 fire, 90/270 ft. A rifle that fires star-hot bolts of plasma. It kills almost anything it hits, and sometimes its owner.
items.flavor: A rifle that fires star-hot bolts of plasma. It kills almost anything it hits, and sometimes its owner.

items.name: Meltagun
items.desc: 4d8 fire, 20/40 ft. A short-range fusion gun that turns tank armour into dripping slag. The Imperium's answer to big problems.
items.flavor: A short-range fusion gun that turns tank armour into dripping slag. The Imperium's answer to big problems.

items.name: Fusion gun
items.desc: 4d8 fire, 20/40 ft. The Aeldari version of the meltagun: lighter, prettier, just as final.
items.flavor: The Aeldari version of the meltagun: lighter, prettier, just as final.

items.name: Grenade launcher
items.desc: 3d6 piercing, 90/270 ft. Fires grenades well beyond throwing range. Shown with frag; load krak, smoke or anything else and it uses that grenade's effect.
items.flavor: Fires grenades well beyond throwing range. Shown with frag; load krak, smoke or anything else and it uses that grenade's effect.

items.name: Webber
items.desc: 1 bludgeoning, 30/90 ft. A long-barrelled web projector for taking prisoners, or for keeping things in place while you leave.
items.flavor: A long-barrelled web projector for taking prisoners, or for keeping things in place while you leave.

items.name: Heavy stubber
items.desc: 2d6 piercing, 120/480 ft. A belt-fed machine gun found on every ship turret and hive militia barricade.
items.flavor: A belt-fed machine gun found on every ship turret and hive militia barricade.

items.name: Big shoota
items.desc: 2d8 piercing, 90/360 ft. A shoota, but bigger, louder and with a longer belt. The Orks consider this an improvement in every way.
items.flavor: A shoota, but bigger, louder and with a longer belt. The Orks consider this an improvement in every way.

items.name: Rokkit launcha
items.desc: 3d8 fire, 90/270 ft. A tube, a rokkit and an Ork who believes. Goes off with a bang, eventually, somewhere.
items.flavor: A tube, a rokkit and an Ork who believes. Goes off with a bang, eventually, somewhere.

items.name: Missile launcher
items.desc: 4d6 fire, 150/600 ft. A shoulder-fired launcher shown with frag missiles. Krak missiles turn it into a tank killer (see Ammunition).
items.flavor: A shoulder-fired launcher shown with frag missiles. Krak missiles turn it into a tank killer (see Ammunition).

items.name: Heavy flamer
items.desc: 4d6 fire, 30 ft. A flamer with a backpack tank and a nozzle like a drainpipe. Nothing comes out of the corridor afterwards.
items.flavor: A flamer with a backpack tank and a nozzle like a drainpipe. Nothing comes out of the corridor afterwards.

items.name: Heavy bolter
items.desc: 2d10 piercing, 150/600 ft. A belt-fed bolter that chews through infantry, light vehicles and cover alike. The backbone of many a last stand.
items.flavor: A belt-fed bolter that chews through infantry, light vehicles and cover alike. The backbone of many a last stand.

items.name: Autocannon
items.desc: 3d8 piercing, 200/800 ft. A rapid-firing cannon that throws high-explosive shells. Normally mounted on vehicles; carried by the very strong or the very servitor.
items.flavor: A rapid-firing cannon that throws high-explosive shells. Normally mounted on vehicles; carried by the very strong or the very servitor.

items.name: Lascannon
items.desc: 5d10 radiant, 300/1200 ft. A las weapon built to punch through tank armour at long range. One shot, then a long, nervous wait for the recharge.
items.flavor: A las weapon built to punch through tank armour at long range. One shot, then a long, nervous wait for the recharge.

items.name: Assault cannon
items.desc: 2d8 piercing, 120/480 ft. A rotary cannon that spits a storm of shells. Normally only Space Marine Terminators carry one.
items.flavor: A rotary cannon that spits a storm of shells. Normally only Space Marine Terminators carry one.

items.name: Plasma cannon
items.desc: 4d10 fire, 120/360 ft. A plasma weapon the size of a person. Its shots land like small suns.
items.flavor: A plasma weapon the size of a person. Its shots land like small suns.

items.name: Multi-melta
items.desc: 6d8 fire, 40/80 ft. A twin-barrelled melta for dissolving tanks, bulkheads and gates.
items.flavor: A twin-barrelled melta for dissolving tanks, bulkheads and gates.

items.name: Throwing axe
items.desc: 1d6 slashing, 20/60 ft. A balanced hatchet for throwing. Feral-world warriors carry a brace of them.
items.flavor: A balanced hatchet for throwing. Feral-world warriors carry a brace of them.

items.name: Bolas
items.desc: 1 bludgeoning, 20/60 ft. Weighted cords that wrap round legs. Primitive, cheap and annoyingly effective.
items.flavor: Weighted cords that wrap round legs. Primitive, cheap and annoyingly effective.

items.name: Mono-knife
items.desc: 1d6 piercing. A knife with a monomolecular edge. It cuts through flak, bone and bad decisions.
items.flavor: A knife with a monomolecular edge. It cuts through flak, bone and bad decisions.

items.name: Choppa
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. An Ork cleaver the size of a door. Subtlety was never on the table.
items.flavor: An Ork cleaver the size of a door. Subtlety was never on the table.

items.name: Electro-flail
items.desc: 1d8 bludgeoning. A whip of charged cables used by slavers, Arbites and the more enthusiastic Ecclesiarchy preachers.
items.flavor: A whip of charged cables used by slavers, Arbites and the more enthusiastic Ecclesiarchy preachers.

items.name: Taser goad
items.desc: 1d6 lightning. A Mechanicus prod for herding servitors and other reluctant flesh.
items.flavor: A Mechanicus prod for herding servitors and other reluctant flesh.

items.name: Power maul
items.desc: 1d8 bludgeoning. A club sheathed in a disruption field, the badge of Arbites and enforcers across the Imperium.
items.flavor: A club sheathed in a disruption field, the badge of Arbites and enforcers across the Imperium.

items.name: Power axe
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. An axe whose edge crackles with a disruption field. Favoured by Rogue Trader house guards and Tech-Priests.
items.flavor: An axe whose edge crackles with a disruption field. Favoured by Rogue Trader house guards and Tech-Priests.

items.name: Omnissian axe
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. The sacred axe of the Mechanicus, part tool, part weapon, part prayer.
items.flavor: The sacred axe of the Mechanicus, part tool, part weapon, part prayer.

items.name: Force sword
items.desc: 1d8 slashing. A blade laced with psychoactive circuitry. In a psyker's hand it cuts souls as easily as flesh.
items.flavor: A blade laced with psychoactive circuitry. In a psyker's hand it cuts souls as easily as flesh.

items.name: Force axe
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. A heavy psychic weapon carried by battle-psykers and Librarians.
items.flavor: A heavy psychic weapon carried by battle-psykers and Librarians.

items.name: Power klaw
items.desc: 2d8 bludgeoning. An Ork power claw: huge, crude and capable of folding a man in half.
items.flavor: An Ork power claw: huge, crude and capable of folding a man in half.

items.name: Power fist
items.desc: 2d8 bludgeoning. An armoured gauntlet wrapped in a disruption field. It can tear open a bulkhead, or a tank.
items.flavor: An armoured gauntlet wrapped in a disruption field. It can tear open a bulkhead, or a tank.

items.name: Lightning claw
items.desc: 1d10 slashing. A gauntlet with long energised talons. Usually worn in pairs, by those who like it close and personal.
items.flavor: A gauntlet with long energised talons. Usually worn in pairs, by those who like it close and personal.

items.name: Witchblade
items.desc: 1d8 slashing. An Aeldari psychic blade of wraithbone, sung into shape rather than forged.
items.flavor: An Aeldari psychic blade of wraithbone, sung into shape rather than forged.

items.name: Agoniser
items.desc: 1d6 slashing. A Drukhari whip or blade that fires every pain nerve at once. Victims rarely stay standing to scream.
items.flavor: A Drukhari whip or blade that fires every pain nerve at once. Victims rarely stay standing to scream.

items.name: Daemon blade
items.desc: 2d6 necrotic. A sword with something bound inside it. It whispers, it thirsts, and it is very, very good at what it does.
items.flavor: A sword with something bound inside it. It whispers, it thirsts, and it is very, very good at what it does.

items.name: Crozius arcanum
items.desc: 1d10 bludgeoning. The holy power maul of a Chaplain, topped with a winged skull. Daemons and heretics have extra reason to fear it.
items.flavor: The holy power maul of a Chaplain, topped with a winged skull. Daemons and heretics have extra reason to fear it.

items.name: Chain-glaive
items.desc: 1d12 slashing. A chain blade on a long haft, used to keep the enemy at a screaming distance.
items.flavor: A chain blade on a long haft, used to keep the enemy at a screaming distance.

items.name: Big choppa
items.desc: 2d6 slashing. A two-handed Ork cleaver. The Inaccurate trait applies to the target's survival chances too.
items.flavor: A two-handed Ork cleaver. The Inaccurate trait applies to the target's survival chances too.

items.name: Executioner's axe
items.desc: 2d6 slashing. The great axe of Ecclesiarchy executioners and penitent warriors, heavy with purity seals.
items.flavor: The great axe of Ecclesiarchy executioners and penitent warriors, heavy with purity seals.

items.name: Great power sword
items.desc: 2d8 slashing. A relic-grade two-handed power sword, often a family heirloom passed down a Rogue Trader line.
items.flavor: A relic-grade two-handed power sword, often a family heirloom passed down a Rogue Trader line.

items.name: Force halberd
items.desc: 1d12 slashing. A psychic polearm carried by Grey Knights and other daemon-hunters.
items.flavor: A psychic polearm carried by Grey Knights and other daemon-hunters.

items.name: Thunder hammer
items.desc: 2d10 bludgeoning. A hammer that unleashes a thunderclap of energy on impact. The impact is the easy part to survive.
items.flavor: A hammer that unleashes a thunderclap of energy on impact. The impact is the easy part to survive.

items.name: Daemonhammer
items.desc: 2d10 radiant. A thunder hammer inscribed with litanies of banishment. Against daemons, it deals double damage.
items.flavor: A thunder hammer inscribed with litanies of banishment. Against daemons, it deals double damage.

items.name: Digi-laser
items.desc: 3d6 radiant, 15/30 ft. A jewel-sized laser hidden in a ring. One shot, then a day of looking innocent.
items.flavor: A jewel-sized laser hidden in a ring. One shot, then a day of looking innocent.

items.name: Digi-flamer
items.desc: 2d6 fire, 10 ft. A ring that breathes fire once a day. Popular with Inquisitors who dislike surprises.
items.flavor: A ring that breathes fire once a day. Popular with Inquisitors who dislike surprises.

items.name: Grav-gun
items.desc: 3d8 force, 60/120 ft. An archeotech weapon that crushes its target under its own multiplied weight.
items.flavor: An archeotech weapon that crushes its target under its own multiplied weight.

items.name: Squig in a Jar
items.desc: A small, furious orange squig. Eats anything you post through the lid. Thrown (action, 20 ft): the jar breaks and the squig latches on for 1 piercing damage; the next attack against that target before your next turn has advantage. Then it runs off.

items.name: String of Ork Teef
items.desc: Worthless to Imperials. To an Ork it is real money: hand it over for advantage on one Persuasion or Deception check with an Ork, or to buy one honest answer.

items.name: Broken Servo-Skull
items.desc: Hovers 1 ft off the ground and follows you at walking pace, beeping. Sheds dim light 10 ft. Cannot be switched off. Disadvantage on Stealth while it is with you.

items.name: Commissar's Spare Cap
items.desc: While worn: advantage on Intimidation against Guardsmen and Imperial crew; disadvantage on every other Charisma check, because everyone assumes you are about to shoot them.

items.name: Purity Seal (Slightly Used)
items.desc: Someone else's name is on it. Once, reroll a failed save against Corruption or the Warp. Then the seal peels off and the back reveals it was blessed for a toaster.

items.name: Eternal Tin of Grox Jerky
items.desc: Never empties, never tastes good. Feeds one person a day. Each meal: DC 5 Con save or spend a minute loudly complaining.

items.name: Flask of Unending Recaf
items.desc: Makes one scalding cup an hour. A cup gives advantage on your next save against exhaustion and disadvantage on Stealth for 10 minutes (jitters).

items.name: Vox-Bead (Stuck on an Ork Channel)
items.desc: Permanently tuned to an Ork frequency. Constant shouting. Once a day, a DC 10 Intelligence check picks out something useful: the GM tells you one fact about Orks nearby.

items.name: Votive Candle That Will Not Go Out
items.desc: Burns forever, even underwater or in vacuum. Dim light 5 ft. Impossible to hide while it is lit, and it is always lit.

items.name: Machine-Spirit Appeasement Card
items.desc: Recite it while hitting a malfunctioning device: advantage on one check to fix, start or unjam it, once a day.

items.name: Lho-Stick of Uncertain Age
items.desc: Smoke it for 1 minute of looking extremely cool: advantage on one Intimidation check. Then you cough: disadvantage on Stealth for 1 minute.

items.name: Inquisitorial Rosette (Obvious Forgery)
items.desc: Advantage on Deception against anyone who has never seen a real one. Anyone who has becomes hostile on the spot.

items.name: Crate of Blessed Water
items.desc: 1d4 vials. Thrown at a daemon or warp entity (ranged attack, 20 ft): 1d6 radiant. Against anything else it is just water.

items.name: Lucky Bolt Shell
items.desc: Engraved with a name. Not yours. Once, when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, reroll it. Then the shell is gone.

items.name: The Guardsman's Uplifting Primer
items.desc: Pocket guide to the enemies of Man. Wrong about almost everything. Read it for 10 minutes: advantage on your next check to recall lore about a xenos, but on a 1-5 on the d20 you are confidently and loudly wrong.

items.name: Clockwork Cog-Beetle
items.desc: A brass beetle that follows you. Action: send it to fetch one coin-sized object within 30 ft that is not held.

items.name: Box of Grey Ration Bars
items.desc: Ten days of rations. Flavour: grey. Morale: also grey.

items.name: Pocket Plaster Saint
items.desc: When you drop to 0 HP it cracks in half: advantage on your first death save. One use.

items.name: Eldar Waystone Chip
items.desc: Grows warm within 30 ft of a psyker. A psyker who carries it hears faint singing all the time and has disadvantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing.

items.name: Something Rattling in a Sealed Tin
items.desc: Open it: roll on the Special curios table.

items.name: Stasis Lumen-Pole
items.desc: A 10-ft hive-street lumen torn out of the pavement, still lit (bright light 20 ft, always). Two-handed melee, reach, 2d6 bludgeoning. 3 charges, regained at dawn. On a hit, spend a charge: if the target moved this turn, or is a projectile or vehicle, it stops dead (speed 0 until the end of its next turn). If it was standing still, it is flung 15 ft and knocked prone. DC 15 Str save negates.

items.name: Mag-Clamp of Absolute Stubbornness
items.desc: Press the rune: it locks in place in space and will not move. Holds 8,000 lb; DC 30 Str check to shift it 10 ft. Press again to release. On a moving voidship, "in place" means relative to the ship. Do not test this the other way.

items.name: Grot-in-a-Box
items.desc: Rusty ammo crate, 3 uses a day. Action: open it and roll d6. 1-2: a grot with a shoota far too big for it (goblin, ranged). 3-4: a grot with a pointy stick (goblin). 5: a squig on a lead (giant badger). 6: a grot that steals something and runs; it comes back in an hour with a roll on the Loot table. It obeys simple orders on your turn and vanishes after 1 hour or at 0 HP.

items.name: Mug of Eternal Recaf
items.desc: Say the word. "Pour": 1 gallon of recaf. "Brew": 5 gallons. "Purge": 30 gallons in a 30-ft line, 1 ft wide: DC 13 Str save or knocked prone and 1d4 fire from scalding. Once a day a cup gives advantage on a save against exhaustion.

items.name: The Emperor's Lucky Grox Toe
items.desc: Requires bonding (Faith). Once a day, when you roll a 1 on a d20, reroll it. It smells a little worse each time. After 13 uses it is officially a holy relic, and the Ecclesiarchy wants it back.

items.name: Bottled Daemon of Bad Advice
items.desc: A tiny warp-thing in a stasis jar. Once a day, ask it one yes-or-no question: it answers truthfully. Each question: DC 12 Wis save or gain 1 Corruption. It never stops asking you to open the jar. Do not open the jar.

items.name: Gellar Umbrella
items.desc: Bonus action to open. Nothing falls on you while it is open: rain, ash, blood, debris, small meteorites. Half cover against attacks from directly above. Once a day, jump while holding it and you float down 60 ft a round with no falling damage.

items.name: Stolen Waaagh! Banner
items.desc: Action: plant it (once a day, 1 minute). Allies within 30 ft add 1d4 to melee damage but cannot take the Disengage action. Orks within 60 ft gain advantage on melee attacks and must attack the nearest creature, even each other. Any Ork who sees you carrying it will hunt you personally.

items.name: Portable Bulkhead
items.desc: A folded hatch. Once a day, slap it on a wall, floor or ceiling up to 10 ft thick: it opens a 5-ft passage through for 10 minutes, then the hole seals and the hatch drops off. Whatever is in the passage when it closes is pushed out the nearest end.

items.name: Grox Cube
items.desc: A 2-inch cube. Throw it: it unfolds into a full-grown, deeply unhappy grox (riding horse stats, pack animal). Command word folds it back. If the grox drops to 0 HP it folds up and cannot be used again for 7 days.

items.name: Mask of a Thousand Saints
items.desc: An iron devotional mask. Bonus action: change its face to any expression or any saint. Once a day, advantage on a Deception or Persuasion check. Priests find it either inspiring or heretical (GM rolls).

items.name: Servo-Skull "Brother Snark"
items.desc: Sentient, hovering, rude. Bonus action: it takes the Help action for an ally within 30 ft (once per short rest). Whenever you roll a natural 1, it says something about it, loudly, that everyone within 100 ft can hear.

items.name: Warp-Touched Throne Coin
items.desc: 3 uses a day. Bonus action: flip it. Heads: you teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see. Tails: you swap places with the nearest other creature, friend or foe. You may not choose the result.

propText.Scatter: Within 10 ft, roll the damage dice twice and use the higher total.
propText.Burst: Spend 3 shots: 10-ft cube, Dex save (DC 8 + prof + Dex) or take weapon damage.
propText.Explosive: On a crit, roll damage dice three times instead of twice.
propText.Overheat: On a natural 1, take the weapon's damage; unusable until a short rest.
propText.Silent: Firing does not reveal your position.
propText.Chain (crit +1d6): On a critical hit, add 1d6 damage.
propText.Power: Ignores resistance to slashing/bludgeoning/piercing from mundane armour.
propText.Shock: On a hit, the target can't take reactions until its next turn.
propText.Clip: Shots before reloading; reload is an action (bonus action with Crossbow Expert).
propText.Jam: Non-Reliable guns jam on a natural 1; clear with an action.
propText.Two-handed: Needs both hands to attack with.
propText.Light: Small and quick: works with two-weapon fighting.
propText.Finesse: Use Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage.
propText.Versatile: One or two hands; two hands use the next die size up.
propText.Reach: Adds 5 ft to your melee reach.
propText.Thrown: Can be thrown at the range shown, using the same ability as a melee attack.
propText.Heavy: Needs Strength 13 (melee) or Dexterity 13 (ranged), or attacks have disadvantage. Small creatures have disadvantage.
propText.Loading: Only one shot per action, bonus action or reaction, however many attacks you have.
propText.Brace: If you moved this turn, attacks have disadvantage unless you spent a bonus action bracing it (or you are prone or resting it on cover).
propText.Blast: On a hit, other creatures within 5 ft of the target make a DC 13 Dex save or take half the damage. On a miss, the shot still lands near the target: everything within 5 ft of it makes that save.
propText.Flame: No attack roll. Everything in a cone as long as the range shown makes a DC 13 Dex save: full damage on a fail, half on a success. Ignores half and three-quarters cover. Creatures that fail catch fire (1d4 fire at the start of each turn until someone uses an action to douse them).
propText.Melta: Within the first range number, roll the damage dice twice and add them together. Against objects, vehicles and constructs at that range, roll them three times.
propText.Rending: Scores a critical hit on a 19 or 20.
propText.Toxic: On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Con save or is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
propText.Concussive: On a hit, a Large or smaller target makes a DC 14 Str save or is knocked prone.
propText.Force: In a psyker's hands: once per turn on a hit, spend a power slot to add 1d8 psychic damage per slot level.
propText.Unwieldy: Too heavy to swing fast: only one attack with it per turn, and no opportunity attacks with it.
propText.Pair: Made to be used in pairs. With one in each hand, your bonus-action attack adds your ability modifier to damage.
propText.Haywire: Deals double damage to constructs, servitors, vehicles and anything in powered armour. A device it hits shuts down until the end of its next turn.
propText.Inaccurate: Ork engineering: attack rolls with it take a −2 penalty.
propText.Accurate: If you have not moved this turn, add +2 to the attack roll.
propText.Storm: Twin barrels: once per turn when you hit, fire again at the same target for one more shot (a second attack roll).
propText.Snare: Deals no lasting harm: on a hit the target is restrained (escape with a DC 13 Str or Dex check, as an action).
propText.Bayonet: Has a blade fitted: you can make melee attacks with it for 1d6 piercing (Strength).
propText.Hidden: Built into a ring, glove or ornament. It can only be spotted by someone who searches you closely.
propText.Recharge: Its charge comes back each dawn.
propText.Cursed: Daemon-bound. Each day you carry it, make a DC 12 Wis save or gain 1 Corruption. It does not want to be put down.
